experiment: PadChest longitudinal comparative-fact editing DEV v1
main_method: MDU150 recipe, new separate dual-image DEV expert bank; existing main150 unchanged
candidate_source: 61 source-sorted finding sentences associated with pleural effusion or alveolar pattern and improving/stable/worsening
selection: First complete lexicographic patient-disjoint assignment: six probe strata followed by six anchor strata; labels pleural effusion/alveolar pattern, states improving/stable/worsening. Source image ID order and original finding order; no model-based backfill.
source_evidence_limit: Definite bilingual comparative finding text plus concordant official metadata pointers. Independent prior patient/date/report verification is incomplete. This is source-agreement DEV, not independent clinical truth or a held-out test. All candidates involve patients exposed in earlier T5.
original_split: Preserved privately as provenance; this small exposed DEV panel mixes source splits and makes no official train/test performance claim.
input: Two native image tokens, two independently deterministically processed real images, earlier then later. Adjacent image placeholders preserve one exact contiguous visual span for inherited runtime metadata. No source report/progression/answer provided in question; all three response options appear identically in all questions.
Base_eligibility: Only CORE-confirmed wrong native anchor answers. All six anchors scored once; correct and UNKNOWN excluded without replacement. Probe correctness is not an admission gate. A zero-error or missing-class cohort remains a reported outcome.
scoring: Unchanged MEDPROP_SMALL4_CORE_FULL_SOURCE_V1, gpt-6-astra medium, one attempt per new exact payload, exact accepted payload reuse, inherited failures UNKNOWN; no heuristic conversion of an unparsed answer to a wrong answer.

training.MDU: Unchanged fixed C160+MED160+MDU160, TT88/7168 parameters, original curvature/calibration resources; five source-only native/FIT views. Answer-token partition unchanged, no task-specific tuning.
training.BALANCEDIT: Project paper-spec recipe, native-only50, independent writers plus real R0 bank
training.GRACE: Benchmark100/cosine eps1/final-up-projection with the declared prompt/cache repair
training.LORA: rank16 alpha16 all LM MLP AdamW5e-5 fixed5
training.MEND: Not admitted: matched trained meta-editor unavailable

evaluation: Single and actual final bank; native, four training FIT rewrites (reported as training fit), two unseen paraphrases, one same-disease probe for each of the three true progressions. Patient-disjoint edit/probe pools. Same native dual-image interface/FP32 decoder and frozen FP16 multimodal prefill for all methods.
mechanical_gates: Exactly two native image markers and two image tensors
Ordered per-image pixels and identities; swapping changes ordered pair identity
Two realized visual feature blocks and target-only label masking
Exact source training-token/prompt binding across all five views
Comparator first-source Base output token parity
Saved state parity and GRACE cache/no-cache parity
primary_metrics: Unseen three-state probe balanced accuracy (class-macro CORE bounds)
Joint native plus all three same-disease probes correct, fixed edit denominator
secondary_metrics: Retention among CORE-confirmed pre-correct non-target probes, with its denominator
Pre/post CORE probe accuracy and bounds
controls: Constant-class and edit-answer-copy controls: 33.33% three-state balanced accuracy and 0% native-plus-three-state joint success analytically, if all three probe classes present. No promise of main-method superiority.
uncertainty: Report fixed-denominator UNKNOWN bounds. Repeated probes across edited states are dependent; six or fewer source patients and six probe patients do not support a confirmatory superiority claim. No nominal iid confidence interval or resampling of model outputs.

budgets.original_clock: Starts at first CPU candidate construction, shared by setup, repairs, waiting, Base, CORE, training and evaluation; no reset

lifecycle: Preserve new MDU final canonical bank and one independent small local backup. Comparator states retired only after single, true final bank and save/load consumers complete. No checkpoint reconstruction, data downloads, changes to old T5 or historical-state deletion.
stop: First failed mechanical/admission gate stops that dependent pipeline with durable failure; no score-based recipe/prompt/cohort changes. Budget guard terminates only owned process groups. Finite collection/scoring/publication dependency, no duplicate recurring monitor.
publication: Source, preregistration, aggregate results and execution limitations only; raw CXR, patient IDs/dates, pair manifests, full answers, source phrases, weights and private paths remain private.
